name: Intruder in the repair shed
description: Halla discovered the Dragon Knight from the Copper Oar planting a tarred parcel beneath a repair hull. Halla attempted to approach with both axes drawn; the Knight heard him before striking distance.
summary: Rules correction: only the first exchange was legal. Halla attack 62/81 and Knight broadsword parry 57/65 both succeeded; the blow was fully parried. Later rolls 100 and 15 were invalid extra proactive attacks, discarded with no Luck spent and no damage.

combatants.name: Dragon Knight at the Copper Oar
